sources.title: A Universal Kaluza-Klein Graviton Cascade Rate

evidence.text: Uses Gauss–Codazzi decomposition, background Einstein equations, Israel junction conditions and GHY boundary cancellations to obtain the graviton action. A Weyl transformation maps non-minimal scalar couplings to Einstein frame and absorbs their background effect into the warp factor.

sources.title: Near Threshold Kaluza-Klein Graviton Decays and the Dark Dimension

evidence.text: Bound cascade overlaps using profile completeness, then sum daughter channels. For cosmology, sum decay photons over the freeze-in tower, include survival and redshift, and compare bin-integrated signals with archival Galactic and isotropic gamma-ray spectra.

sources.title: A Universal Kaluza-Klein Graviton Cascade Rate

evidence.text: Expands the action to cubic order, applies on-shell mode equations and integration by parts, and sums massive-spin-2 polarizations. Large-mode WKB overlaps and zeta-function channel sums supply the tower scaling estimates.

sources.title: Near Threshold Kaluza-Klein Graviton Decays and the Dark Dimension

evidence.text: Express the surviving three-graviton vertex as the square of a color-stripped Yang–Mills vertex. Use massive transverse-traceless polarization sums for the width and a parent-rest-frame partial-wave argument for its threshold behavior.
